offer.text: The children do love sweet berries, but the bushes scratch so. Could you pick a dozen for them?

accept.text: Mind the thorns! The little ones will be over the moon.

decline.text: No treats for the children today, I suppose.

ready.text: Twelve plump berries! The children will cheer when they see these.

complete.text: You've made a whole row of little ones smile. Thank you.
